caseName: Securities Investor Protection Corp. v. Ida Fishman Revocable Trust
caseNameFull: SECURITIES INVESTOR PROTECTION CORPORATION v. IDA FISHMAN REVOCABLE TRUST

opinions.text: Motion of Academics for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of Certain “Net Loser” Customers for leave to file a brief as amici curiae granted. Motion of National Association of Bankruptcy Trustees for leave to file a brief as amicus curiae granted. Petition for writ of certiorari to the United States Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit denied.
